entities.label: alert wording rule
as: Daniel Okafor wants fraud alerts worded tersely: one number, then one action
Fraud alert messages to the ops queue are two sentences at most: the number that triggered the alert, then the action.

relations.label: approved
relations.quote: Example he approved: "Velocity 7 txns in 10 min on card ending 4411. Hold and call the cardholder."
